Method of Attack: Authentication bypass allowing unauthenticated network clients to access functionality
Directory traversal enabling unconstrained access to the filesystem of the master server
Exploitation of ZeroMQ protocol to bypass authentication and authorization controls
Impacted Systems: Minions connected to the master server
Attack Vector: Directory traversal in the wheel module
Indicators of Compromise: ASCII strings '_prep_auth_info' or '_send_pub' in data sent to the request server port
Ports 4505 and 4506 being exposed to hostile networks
